explanations: dispatch() builds its shortlist from the drivers that are available at that moment, then awaits the routing service before calling markBusy. While it waits, other dispatch calls run, see the same driver as still available, and shortlist them too. Each one then marks that driver busy for its own ride and overwrites the last. This is a check-then-act race across an await. The fix checks availability again right after the await, in the same synchronous step as markBusy, so no other request can run between the check and the claim. A driver someone else took in the meantime is skipped for the next candidate.
